connectedNotice: Connected to GitHub for this session.
stale: The workspace or publishing destination has changed since this edition was prepared. Prepare a new edition, or explicitly review this retained edition for publishing.
confirm: I have reviewed this website and its media for sharing.
confirmRequired: Please review the website and confirm it is ready to share.
empty: No prepared editions yet. Use Review website in Publishing or Prepare edition in the website editor.
workspaceChanged: The workspace changed. Reopen Website preparations.
selectionGuidance: Expand a record to choose content for this edition. Your saved records stay unchanged. Unchanged records keep their public selection.
rollbackReview: Review this retained edition for publishing
remoteActivate: Putting the new files in place
remoteRemove: Removing files the website no longer has
remoteConfirmed: Published. Check the live website to verify every file.
remoteCheckEmpty: Signed in. The website folder is empty and ready for the first publication.
remoteCheckExisting: Signed in. The website folder already holds other files; same-named files will be replaced and all others kept.
remoteCheckOwned: Signed in. This website folder holds this website's earlier publication.
sshConfirmed: Remote release verified; live website verification is separate
liveVerified: The live website is verified: all {count} files match the reviewed release; {removed} removed URLs return not found.
livePending: Remote publication confirmed; live website verification is separate.
liveRemoved: A removed URL is still accessible or its absence could not be established. Check the host and caches, then retry.
liveMissing: The server did not return this file successfully.
liveMismatch: The served bytes do not match the reviewed edition.
liveUnavailable: The request failed or timed out.
liveManifestInvalid: The served manifest or file inventory does not match this deployment.
liveVerificationMetadata: Publish a reviewed edition again to restore the information needed for live verification.
copyFallback: Automatic copying is unavailable. Select and copy the text above.
replacementArchive: Before replacement, create branch {branch} at the current commit {commit}. The archived files and history remain available there.
replacementOptions: Replace an existing website or application
replacementGuidance: Choose this only when the new website should replace the existing contents of the selected branch or folder. Review every removal before approving. Creating this review does not change GitHub.
replacementArchiveGuidance: Enter an unused branch name to keep the current files before replacement. Use letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores. Leave empty to retain Git history without creating another branch. Repository workflows may also run for the new branch.
withdrawnText: This website is no longer published here. Copies made elsewhere before its withdrawal are not affected.
